title: Quesillo
description: Quesillo is a dish from Venezuela featuring chicken egg, sweetened condensed milk, whole cow milk. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Heat the listed ingredients over moderate heat, stirring only as needed, for about 9 minutes until amber and fragrant.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Place the caramel-lined custard mold into a hot water bath and bake at 160°C until the custard is cooked and just set.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 180 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
